toegepas.voor: Die verskil tussen die twee is meer as groot en klein.
toegepas.na: Die verskil tussen die twee is meer as net groot en klein.
toegepas.rede_vinder: 'meer as net' is the natural Afrikaans form of this contrast; without 'net' the sentence reads oddly.
toegepas.fout: 'meer as groot en klein' without 'net' reads oddly as a contrast in Afrikaans.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'meer as net groot en klein' is the natural form and the meaning is unchanged; the heading is not touched.

toegepas.blok: Hoekom die werk in die stad bymekaar is
toegepas.voor: Elke dag koop 'n stad se baie mense kos en ander goed.
toegepas.na: Die baie mense in 'n stad koop elke dag kos en ander goed.
toegepas.rede_vinder: "'n stad se baie mense" is a wooden possessive; 'die baie mense in 'n stad' is natural and keeps the meaning.
toegepas.fout: "'n stad se baie mense" is a wooden possessive and the fronted 'Elke dag koop' is stiff.
toegepas.rede_keurder: Same people, same action, same time, in natural word order.

toegepas.blok: Hoekom die werk in die stad bymekaar is
toegepas.voor: Elkeen van hulle het mense nodig om te werk.
toegepas.na: Elkeen van hulle het werkers nodig.
toegepas.rede_vinder: 'het mense nodig om te werk' can be read as needing people in order to work; 'het werkers nodig' says it plainly.
toegepas.fout: 'het mense nodig om te werk' is roundabout and can be read as needing people in order to work.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'het werkers nodig' says the same thing plainly and fits the next sentence about asking for work.

toegepas.voor: Werk, en werk wat beter betaal
toegepas.na: Werk en werk wat beter betaal
toegepas.rede_vinder: AWS 2017 as applied here: no comma before 'en' between parts of one sentence; the reviewer may judge the pause worth keeping.
toegepas.fout: Comma before 'en' between parts of one phrase, against the AWS 2017 as this pipeline applies it.
toegepas.rede_keurder: No comma before 'en' when it does not join two sentences with their own subject and verb; the meaning is unchanged.

toegepas.voor: Huise en water en elektrisiteit en vervoer
toegepas.rede_vinder: The repeated 'en' makes a plain list read childishly; commas with one final 'en' is the normal list form.
toegepas.fout: The run of 'en ... en ... en' makes a plain list read childishly.
toegepas.rede_keurder: The normal list form with commas and one final 'en' keeps all four items and the meaning.

toegepas.blok: Die trek loop nie een rigting nie
toegepas.voor: Party van hulle kom 'n paar jaar later weer terug.
toegepas.na: Party wat wegtrek, kom 'n paar jaar later weer terug.
toegepas.rede_vinder: 'hulle' points back to the people who do NOT move away, so 'come back' has no clear subject; naming those who leave fixes the reference.
toegepas.fout: 'hulle' points back to 'almal' in the sentence about those who do not move away, so it is unclear who comes back.
toegepas.rede_keurder: Saying 'those who move away' fixes the reference, keeps the quantifier 'Party' and adds no fact; the comma between the two verbs is correct.

toegepas.blok: Die trek loop nie een rigting nie
toegepas.rede_vinder: Afrikaans says 'op albei plekke', not 'in albei plekke'.
toegepas.fout: 'in albei plekke' is the wrong preposition; Afrikaans says 'op 'n plek'.
toegepas.rede_keurder: It is the same meaning (having a house at both locations) with the idiomatic preposition.

toegepas.blok: Die trek loop nie een rigting nie
toegepas.rede_vinder: Work and services do not 'staan'; 'bymekaar is' matches the lesson's own heading and the urban block.
toegepas.fout: Work and services do not 'staan'; the verb fits buildings, not work.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'bymekaar is' is the plain verb and matches the lesson's own heading and the urban block, and the meaning is unchanged.

laat_vaar.voor: Die naaste hospitaal of kollege is ook dikwels ver.
laat_vaar.na: Die naaste hospitaal of kollege is ook dikwels ver weg.
laat_vaar.rede_vinder: A bare predicative 'ver' at sentence end is stiff; 'ver weg' is the natural form.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: Predicative 'ver' at the end of the sentence is ordinary, natural Afrikaans, so 'ver weg' is only a lateral move.

na_skrywer.voor: terwyl hulle werk en 'n vaste huis soek
na_skrywer.na: terwyl hulle na werk en 'n vaste huis soek
na_skrywer.rede_vinder: 'werk' can be read as the verb (while they work); 'na werk ... soek' makes clear they are looking for work.
na_skrywer.fout: 'terwyl hulle werk en 'n vaste huis soek' can be read as 'while they work' or as 'while they look for work'.
na_skrywer.rede_keurder: The ambiguity is real, but the proposal settles it to one of the two readings, and which one is meant is for the writer to decide.
na_skrywer.waarom: the reviewer sent it to the writer

na_skrywer.voor: waar minder mense op elke stuk grond woon as in 'n dorp of stad, in gemeenskappe en op plase
na_skrywer.na: in gemeenskappe en op plase, waar minder mense op elke stuk grond woon as in 'n dorp of stad
na_skrywer.rede_vinder: The trailing 'in gemeenskappe en op plase' dangles after the comparison; placing it after 'Buite die dorpe en stede' reads cleanly with the same words.
na_skrywer.fout: In the definition, 'in gemeenskappe en op plase' trails after the comparison and dangles.
na_skrywer.rede_keurder: This is a glossary definition shared word for word across lessons, so the word order may change only through the writer.
na_skrywer.waarom: the reviewer sent it to the writer

vlae.rede: Block heading: the separable verb is written apart, and joined as 'aftrek' it means 'deduct'; something like 'Waarvandaan mense wegtrek' would be correct, but a heading may not be applicable by script.

vlae.blok: Die trek loop nie een rigting nie
vlae.teks: Die trek loop nie een rigting nie
vlae.rede: Block heading: 'loop nie net in een rigting nie' is the idiomatic form; left as a flag because it is a heading.

vlae.teks: werk wat beter betaal as die werk by die huis
vlae.rede: 'by die huis' here means the home area people come from, but a learner can read 'die werk by die huis' as housework; the same phrase recurs in 'Waarvan mense af trek'. Fixing it means choosing a wording for the home area, which is a content choice.
